assessment: This is a valuable paper investigating hemispheric asymmetries in brain functional connectivity. The authors quantify this asymmetry using a solid methodology that capitalises on recent developments in functional gradients, and they further ask if these asymmetries are heritable and how they compare between humans and macaque monkeys. The results suggest a genetic underpinning of brain functional asymmetry, particularly in areas supporting unique human functions. These findings may help further our understanding of brain asymmetries.
